h1: Choose the amount of resume help you actually need.
lede: A job search can need a clean tool, a focused second pair of eyes, or a full career-story rewrite. Start with the target, the gap, and the deliverable—not the loudest promise.
body:
Disclosure: this guide links to ResumeATS, a service I operate. The $99 concierge option is a direct service offer, not an affiliate link. No resume service can guarantee interviews, offers, or a particular employer’s decision; review the scope, facts, revisions, turnaround, refund terms, and privacy details before paying.

Need one focused application? Request the $99 concierge slot or continue with the self-service builder if you want to make the edits yourself.

Self-service builder

Best when your facts and target are clear and you want to control the edits, exports, and job-specific tailoring yourself.

$99 concierge

Best when one target job needs a focused cleanup, tailoring pass, and ATS-readable PDF and Word copies without buying a broader package.

Broader support

Best when your story, role direction, LinkedIn profile, cover letter, or career transition needs deeper strategy and multiple deliverables.

Name the target job

Use one real job description when possible. A resume that tries to speak to every role usually becomes vague, repetitive, and harder to evaluate.

Separate facts from positioning

Confirm dates, titles, metrics, tools, and responsibilities first. Then improve ordering, wording, and emphasis without inventing achievements or credentials.

Check the actual deliverables

Ask whether you receive an editable Word file, a PDF, a targeted version, revision access, and a clear handoff. Do not confuse a visual preview with a usable application file.

Review ATS readability

Use conventional headings, selectable text, consistent dates, and a layout that survives parsing. ATS compatibility is a practical formatting goal, not a guarantee of ranking or employment.

Protect personal information

Share only what the service needs, understand who can access the documents, and check retention, deletion, payment, and refund terms before uploading sensitive career history.

Need one focused application? ResumeATS currently presents a $99 concierge option for cleaning up one resume, tailoring it to one job description, and delivering ATS-readable PDF and Word copies within two business days. Request a $99 concierge slot or start with the self-service builder.
